findings.contract_clause: SERVICE.md: Inputs — the test-record evidence manifest
findings.detail: The atom returned a 200 OK status for malformed input (asset as integer, record as string) instead of a 422 Unprocessable Entity.

notes: The atom correctly identifies pass/fail states and handles missing data as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. However, it fails to implement proper HTTP error handling for malformed input, returning 200 OK instead of the expected 422 status code.
